prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Japanese woman — the personification of Kyoto — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Kyoto as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Kyoto with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall
Season: high summer in the basin — but she is indoors: show the season only through a window or in her clothing; no blossoms, petals, falling leaves, snow or trees inside the room.
Time of day: midday — bright, even daylight.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Ifa from Genshin Impact — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a fitted strapless mini dress, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned to the side; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her shoulders, chest and hips turn away from the camera together, no twist at the waist; her chest stays turned away; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the image's right side, mostly hidden behind her body — at most its hand shows beside her hip.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — her near arm, on the image's left side toward the camera.
LEGS: weight even on both legs.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it, and not the object she holds in it; only the costume's own pieces.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
